description: Thompson Sampling (Beta distribution variant selection) must ONLY exist in metabob-rpc-api. metabob-opencode must call rpc-api endpoint for template selection.
expectedBehavior: When opencode needs to select a template variant, it calls POST /v1/templates/select-variant in rpc-api. No Beta sampling logic exists in opencode.

components.currentBehavior: Samples from Beta distribution using random.betavariate(alpha, beta). Falls back to mean of Beta distribution on error.
components.desiredBehavior: KEEP AS-IS - Core ML sampling function correctly placed in rpc-api

components.currentBehavior: Implements cache-aside pattern: checks Redis cache first, on miss loads from SurrealDB and populates cache. Returns templates with Thompson Sampling metrics.
components.desiredBehavior: KEEP AS-IS - Proper cache-aside pattern for read operations

components.currentBehavior: Creates template variant: generates IDs, stores in Redis first (lines 351-361), then initializes Thompson Sampling metrics in Redis (lines 363-377). NO SurrealDB write.
components.desiredBehavior: REFACTOR - Write to SurrealDB first (primary storage), then Redis (cache). Implement compensating transaction on failure.
components.gap: CRITICAL - Dual-write pattern should be: SurrealDB first (source of truth), Redis second (cache). Current implementation only writes to Redis.

components.currentBehavior: DUAL-WRITE with Redis-first pattern: (1) Atomic Redis update using WATCH/MULTI/EXEC (lines 509-586), (2) SurrealDB writes (lines 587-639), (3) Compensating rollback on SurrealDB failure (lines 641-683). Updates Thompson Sampling parameters (thompson_alpha, thompson_beta) in both stores.
components.desiredBehavior: REFACTOR - Invert order: SurrealDB first (source of truth), then Redis (cache-aside). This matches cache-aside pattern used in list_templates.
components.gap: ARCHITECTURAL INCONSISTENCY - Should be: SurrealDB write → Redis cache update → rollback Redis on SurrealDB failure. Current order: Redis update → SurrealDB write → rollback Redis on failure.

components.currentBehavior: Thompson Sampling algorithm: (1) Finds all variants (line 832), (2) Loads metrics from Redis (lines 849-857), (3) Samples from Beta(alpha, beta) for each (line 860), (4) Selects highest sample (line 876), (5) Increments selection count in Redis (lines 884-906), (6) Returns template with selection metadata.
components.desiredBehavior: REFACTOR - Add SurrealDB write for selection tracking, implement cache-aside for metrics reads (if Redis misses, load from SurrealDB and populate cache).
components.gap: INCOMPLETE - Selection count increments only in Redis (not persisted to SurrealDB). Metrics reads have no fallback to SurrealDB on cache miss.

components.currentBehavior: POST /templates/{activity_id}/select endpoint delegates to select_variant_thompson_sampling action. Returns selected template with Thompson Sampling metadata.
components.desiredBehavior: KEEP AS-IS - Endpoint correctly delegates to action layer

components.currentBehavior: Delegates Thompson Sampling to RPC API: (1) Calls RpcHttpClient.selectTemplateVariant (line 165), (2) Extracts selection metadata (lines 168-173), (3) Loads candidate template if selected (lines 197-219), (4) Falls back to stable on error (lines 220-249).
components.desiredBehavior: KEEP AS-IS - Correctly delegates ML logic to RPC API

components.currentBehavior: HTTP client for RPC API: POSTs to /v2/activities/templates/{activityId}/select, returns TemplateSelectionResponse with template and Thompson Sampling metadata.

Updates template metrics in SurrealDB after execution: incremental aggregation for averages, updates Thompson Sampling parameters (thompson_alpha = successes + 1, thompson_beta = failures + 1) at lines 178-181.
components.desiredBehavior: KEEP AS-IS - Correctly updates SurrealDB (primary storage)

components.currentBehavior: Inserts execution record to SurrealDB with full context (variant_id, success, tokens, cost, duration).
components.desiredBehavior: KEEP AS-IS - Correctly persists execution data

templateSelection.current: OpenCode → RPC API POST /templates/{id}/select → select_variant_thompson_sampling → [Redis: Load metrics] → [Beta sampling] → [Redis: Increment selection count] → Return template
templateSelection.desired: OpenCode → RPC API POST /templates/{id}/select → select_variant_thompson_sampling → [Redis: Load metrics, fallback to SurrealDB on miss] → [Beta sampling] → [SurrealDB: Record selection] → [Redis: Update cache] → Return template
templateSelection.gap: Missing: (1) SurrealDB fallback on Redis cache miss, (2) Selection tracking in SurrealDB

executionRecording.current: OpenCode → RPC API POST /execution → record_execution_result → [Redis: Atomic update with WATCH/MULTI/EXEC] → [SurrealDB: Insert execution + Update metrics] → [On SurrealDB failure: Rollback Redis]
executionRecording.desired: [SurrealDB: Insert execution + Update metrics with transaction] → [Redis: Update cache] → [On Redis failure: Log warning, continue (cache-aside tolerates cache misses)]
executionRecording.gap: Order inverted: Should write to primary storage (SurrealDB) first, then cache (Redis). Current pattern: cache-first with compensating transaction.

templateCreation.current: create_template → [Generate IDs] → [Redis: Store template] → [Redis: Initialize metrics] → Return
templateCreation.desired: [SurrealDB: Insert template] → [Redis: Cache template with TTL] → [On Redis failure: Log warning, continue] → Return
templateCreation.gap: CRITICAL: No SurrealDB write. Template only exists in Redis (volatile cache). Should persist to SurrealDB first.

phase3RefactoringPlan.objective: Implement consistent cache-aside pattern: SurrealDB as primary storage, Redis as cache layer

changes.change: Add SurrealDB write before Redis cache: (1) Insert template to SurrealDB, (2) Initialize metrics in SurrealDB, (3) Populate Redis cache with TTL, (4) On Redis failure: log warning and continue (non-fatal)
changes.rationale: Templates must persist beyond Redis cache eviction. SurrealDB is source of truth.

changes.change: Invert write order: (1) SurrealDB transaction (insert execution + update metrics atomically), (2) Update Redis cache (read-modify-write for Thompson Sampling params), (3) On Redis failure: log warning and continue (cache-aside tolerates misses)
changes.rationale: Align with cache-aside pattern. SurrealDB is source of truth, Redis is performance layer. Redis failure should be non-fatal.
changes.risk: Medium - Changes write order, requires careful testing of rollback scenarios

changes.change: Add SurrealDB operations: (1) On metrics cache miss (line 851): query SurrealDB and populate Redis, (2) Record selection to SurrealDB for analytics (new table: template_selections), (3) Keep Redis selection count increment for fast queries
changes.rationale: Enable cache recovery on Redis failures. Track selection history for learning and analysis.

validationCriteria: Template creation persists to SurrealDB before caching in Redis
Execution recording writes to SurrealDB first, then updates Redis cache
Template selection falls back to SurrealDB on Redis cache miss
Selection history is tracked in SurrealDB for analytics
Redis failures are non-fatal and logged as warnings
Thompson Sampling parameters (alpha, beta) remain consistent between SurrealDB and Redis
All validation harness tests pass after refactoring

architecturalBoundary.principle: ML selection logic belongs in rpc-api. OpenCode delegates via HTTP API.

No Thompson Sampling orchestration in OpenCode (removed in Phase 2 enforcement)
